domain: Demographic & Social Science (income and poverty statistics from tax returns)

distractor_reasons.irs_soi_zip_code_data_ty2022_extract.csv: the tax year 2022 statistics, kept from the 2026 allocation; the policy counts the latest year the IRS has published at the plan date, tax year 2023
distractor_reasons.county_zip_relationship_2023q4.xlsx: the same address counts from county to ZIP code; the policy shares each ZIP code's returns among counties, which only the ZIP code to county file gives

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task475/generator); the council, its counties, agencies, people, ZIP codes and records are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the IRS Statistics of Income individual ZIP code data layout and field names (N1, A00100, N59660, A59660, AGI_STUB) and the earned income credit parameters for tax years 2022 and 2023 (Rev. Proc. 2021-45 and 2022-38), U.S. government works in the public domain
